prompts.display_text: Pin a country with a temple standing today that Dieter F. Uchtdorf dedicated or rededicated.
prompts.text_original: A country where Dieter F. Uchtdorf dedicated or rededicated a temple now in use (as of October 2026).
prompts.citation: ChurchofJesusChristTemples.org chronological list (dedicated-by column), read 26 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: Dieter F. Uchtdorf has dedicated or rededicated temples on several continents. New temples he dedicated include Quetzaltenango Guatemala (2011), Manaus Brazil (2012), Tegucigalpa Honduras (2013), and Tijuana Mexico, Córdoba Argentina and Trujillo Peru (2015). He also rededicated Frankfurt Germany (2019) and Hamilton New Zealand (2022) after renovation.

answers.name: United States
answers.fact: Fort Lauderdale Florida (2014); Fort Collins Colorado (2016); Tucson Arizona (2017); and others.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country where a new temple was dedicated in 2019 (not rededications).
prompts.text_original: A country where a temple was dedicated in 2019 (not counting rededications).
prompts.citation: Church temple list (original dedication dates), 26 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: 2019 brought first temples to several countries. Rome Italy, Kinshasa Democratic Republic of the Congo, Port-au-Prince Haiti and Lisbon Portugal were each the first in their nations, and Fortaleza Brazil and Arequipa Peru were also dedicated that year. Russell M. Nelson, then President of the Church, dedicated the Rome temple.

prompts.display_text: Pin a South or Southeast Asian country whose official or national language has Book of Mormon text.
prompts.text_original: A country in South or Southeast Asia where an official or national language has Book of Mormon text
prompts.summary: Many languages of South and Southeast Asia have Book of Mormon text, from Thai (1976) and Indonesian (1977) to Nepali (2017) and Burmese (2019). The Philippines alone has eight languages, including Tagalog, Cebuano and Ilokano, and India has Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Bengali and Urdu.

answers.name: Philippines
answers.fact: Tagalog, Cebuano, Ilokano and five more Philippine languages have Book of Mormon text.

answers.name: Indonesia
answers.fact: The Indonesian Book of Mormon appeared in 1977.

answers.name: India
answers.fact: Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Bengali and Urdu all have Book of Mormon text.

answers.name: Thailand
answers.fact: The Thai Book of Mormon appeared in 1976.

answers.name: Cambodia
answers.fact: Cambodian selections came in 1982 and the full text in 2001.

answers.name: Vietnam

answers.name: Laos

prompts.display_text: Pin an African country that Saints names as reached by the gospel by the early 1990s.
prompts.text_original: Saints vol. 4 ch. 27 names these African countries as places the restored gospel had reached by the early 1990s. Pin one.
prompts.summary: After the 1978 revelation, the restored gospel spread quickly across Africa. Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa and Zimbabwe were the first places of strong growth, and by the early 1990s Saints vol. 4 lists many more, from Liberia and Cameroon to Kenya and Madagascar. Missionaries reached Zaire, now the Democratic Republic of the Congo, in 1986.

answers.name: Ghana
answers.fact: One of the four early African strongholds after the 1978 priesthood revelation.

answers.name: Nigeria
answers.fact: Saints names it with Ghana, South Africa and Zimbabwe as where the Church grew first after the 1978 priesthood revelation.

answers.name: South Africa
answers.fact: Saints had been there since the 1850s; growth surged after 1978.

answers.name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
answers.fact: Called Zaire then; missionaries arrived in 1986.

answers.name: Kenya
answers.fact: Part of the East African spread named in the chapter.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country that Saints names as having its first stake by 1970, as McKay's presidency ended.
prompts.text_original: Saints vol. 4 ch. 12: by 1970, at the end of David O. McKay's presidency, these countries had their first stakes. Pin one.
prompts.summary: When David O. McKay became President of the Church in 1951 there were 184 stakes, and by 1970 there were 500. During his presidency the first stakes were organized in Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay, Guatemala, Tonga and Western Samoa. Brazil's São Paulo Stake, created in 1966, was the first in South America.

answers.fact: Named; the Sao Paulo Stake (1966) was the first in South America.
